record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.75 to 0.70. The improvement from 0.8 to 0.75 motivates a neighboring test of stronger norm regularization. Retain width 64, input/output tying, features, topology, scoring, history policy, loss temperature and optimizer. Use the same effective-weight definition during training and prediction, with one checkpoint per category.
